subject.title: [RFC] Multi-Session Architecture: Shared LLM + Isolated Sessions + Public Knowledge Base

question: Should issue #48874 remain as the umbrella RFC, or should maintainers split it into canonical design issues for routing identity, WebUI lifecycle, topic-family semantics, and shared-memory security?
rationale: Current main partially implements several requested surfaces, but the remaining work needs product and security boundaries before code can safely decide what belongs in core, plugins, or docs.

options.title: Split into staged design issues
options.body: Keep this as umbrella context and create narrower canonical issues for the independently reviewable routing, UI, topic, and memory-security tracks.

options.title: Keep one umbrella RFC
options.body: Use this issue for maintainer discussion only and block implementation until a concrete scoped plan is approved.

options.title: Close in favor of existing trackers
options.body: Close this RFC only if maintainers explicitly designate #90916, #27526, and memory/security follow-ups as sufficient canonical replacements.

recommendation.title: Split into staged design issues
recommendation.body: Keep this as umbrella context and create narrower canonical issues for the independently reviewable routing, UI, topic, and memory-security tracks.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant current-main history and discussion context crosses session routing, UI session metadata, and memory docs.
